summary.text: Daniel Conway is the Republican candidate for Ohio House of Representatives District 15 in the November 3, 2026 general election, in which incumbent Chris Glassburn is also running.
A certified public accountant, he said in a Ballotpedia survey that his campaign centers on fiscal discipline, government transparency and school accountability.

paragraphs.text: Daniel Conway earned a bachelor's degree from Cleveland State University in 1987 and works as a certified public accountant.
In a Ballotpedia survey, he described himself as a lifelong West Side Cleveland resident with a 35-year career as a certified public accountant and business consultant.
He said he is the author of more than 40 books on faith, resilience and heritage and a monthly columnist in a local Irish newspaper.
He advanced from the Republican primary on May 5, 2026.

Conway listed three key messages for his campaign: fiscal discipline, lower taxes and smart spending; transparency, accountability and modernization in government; and stronger, accountable schools and workforce readiness.
